paper_metadata.title: Quantum-inspired Computing: Entanglement-enhanced Technique for Short Portfolio in Global Markets

summary: ELSA-GNQTS: quantum-inspired tabu search with global-best guidance, Quantum-Not gate escape mechanism, and an Entanglement Local Search-Assisted (ELSA) neighborhood-refinement step (Hamming-distance-1/2/3/4 neighbors derived from Bell-like |00>+|11>, |01>+|10>, |001>+|110>, |0011>+|1100> entanglement patterns). Applied to short-selling portfolio construction on the top 30 stocks (by market cap, 10-year complete history) in each G7 equity index (FTSE, DJIA, TSX, CAC, NIKKEI, DAX, MIB) from Jan 2013-Dec 2022. Parameters: 10 individuals, 10000 generations, 50 independent runs, theta=0.0002, initial fund 1e9 local currency, sliding window training/testing. Compared against single-stock short-selling (best-trend-ratio stock per period) and against Sharpe-ratio-guided portfolio (same ELSA-GNQTS solver). ELSA-GNQTS-trend-ratio portfolios yield lower risk, lower MDD, higher profit factor, and higher trend ratio than the Sharpe-ratio baseline across all G7 markets.

experiments.description: ELSA-GNQTS short-selling portfolio optimization on 30 largest-cap stocks in each G7 index (FTSE, DJIA, TSX, CAC, NIKKEI, DAX, MIB) over Jan 2013-Dec 2022. Trend ratio objective. Compared with single-stock baseline and Sharpe-ratio-guided ELSA-GNQTS baseline.

algorithm.variant: Entanglement Local Search-Assisted Global-best guided Quantum-inspired Tabu Search with Not Gate (ELSA-GNQTS)
algorithm.ansatz: Binary encoding S_i in {0,1} per stock; beta-matrix b_i = beta_i^2 = |<psi_i|1>|^2 initialized to 0.5; Quantum-Not gate swaps b_i when discrepant global-best/local-worst; ELSA adds Hamming-distance {2,3,4} entanglement-like neighborhood moves.
algorithm.optimizer: Quantum-inspired Tabu Search (GNQTS) + ELSA local search

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary vector S of length n (= 30 per G7 market) indicating stock inclusion; quantum-inspired probability matrix updated via Eq. (3) rules.

problem_instance.dataset_name: G7 equity indices: FTSE, DJIA, TSX, CAC, NIKKEI, DAX, MIB (top 30 stocks each by market cap)

dataset_specification.description: Stocks: WRDS / Yahoo Finance / Investing.com; capitalization: TradingView / Investing.com. Training-to-testing via sliding windows (Y, H, Q, M rebalancing).
